skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 2 combo strikes to a single target for 50% ATK DMG.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 5 combo strikes to each enemy in the entire row for 30% ATK DMG, and restores 20% of max HP to self and same-column allies.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 5 combo strikes to each enemy in the entire row for 35% ATK DMG, and restores 20% of max HP to self and same-column allies.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. Before battle starts, the Fist Fight Demon [Encourages] allies (gains 1 extra Energy at the start of each turn, lasting 2 turns). When battle starts, grants self 50% Ultimate DMG immunity, lasting 2 turns.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. Before battle starts, the Fist Fight Demon [Encourages] allies (gains 1 extra Energy at the start of each turn, lasting 2 turns). When battle starts, grants self 60% Ultimate DMG immunity, lasting 2 turns.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. Before battle starts, the Fist Fight Demon [Encourages] allies (gains 1 extra Energy at the start of each turn, lasting 2 turns). When battle starts, grants self 70% Ultimate DMG immunity, lasting 2 turns.
